config.effectiveWeightDecay: nginx also decays a failed peer's effective weight by weight/max_fails, so re-entry after fail_timeout ramps back in over a few requests
config.failureMetric: connection failures (rc!=0 / empty reply) instead of HTTP 5xx
config.loopbackRemovedBy: harness rm + systemctl reload nginx on both sides
config.probe: raw TLS 1.3 ClientHello with the configured SNI over the stream listener; ssl_preread selects the reality upstream
config.recoveryProbe: the recovery phase runs the whole window (120 probes every 0.5s); it does not stop at the first A
config.stableRecoveryRule: a side counts as recovered only when A keeps being selected to the end of the complete window with no gap longer than 10s and at least 3 A responses
config.upstreamCounters: per nginx worker; the upstream has no shared zone, so each worker removes the peer on its own
